company_info.company_description: "Urban Renewables is a specialist in the design and installation of Solar PV systems across Victoria. With a traditional base as an electrical company, Urban Renewables has been involved in the solar PV industry since early 2010, focusing on providing an informative, reliable and clean service that you would be happy to refer to friends and family. Whether it's for your home or business, Urban Renewables is that smart choice for solar installation and maintenance."

reviews.review_description: I selected Urban Renewables to install our Sigenergy home battery because the way Sean engaged was professional, prompt and technically well prepared. His answers to my questions always made me feel he knew the topic well and I could trust his guidance. After accepting the quote, we moved to the installation phase, carried out by a directly employed team, not contractors. This team was also very impressive, fast quiet, tidy. You could hardly tell they were around during the one full day and a few hours the day after.  The outcome was a super neat installation, with minimal fuss.All up, I say it was a process with a level of professionalism often lacking in this industry, with the result being a system that just looks right and most importantly has operated from day one without a hitch.I paid a little more than the cheapest quote, but I have felt confident and comfortable with my dealings with the team at Urban Renewables all the way, ending in a great installation.
Quick quote with follow up and site inspection, rang on monday installed on tuesday

This is the 3rd system Urban Renewables has installed for me. I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Adrian / Jol and their team are the best in the business. These people are trustworthy and their workmanship is second to noneI have recommended Urban Renewables to all my family and friends and they have all been totally satisfied with the end product

Urban Renewables. Awesome service from start to finish!Fantastic pre-installation service. Extremely knowledgeable sales staff, who spent the time to talk me through all options and answer all my questions, including assisting in providing comparable information so I could easily compare quotes against other providers.Exceptional installation.  Great communication on when the installation would occur and the lead up to it. Installer turned up on time,  was professional and super efficient.Outstanding post installation customer service.  As we all know one key areas that makes a great company stand out from the rest, is if there are problems at a later date. For me this was my energy provider not being able to connect to my inverter, once my electricity meter had been converted for my feed in tariff. Urban Renewables went out of their way to speak directly to the energy company and resolve the issue in a timely and professional manner.  Cannot rate Urban Renewables high enough. So glad I went with them for my solar system.

Just want to share my sincere thanks to Urban Renewables- Sean Sweetser, Installer Jolian and his team installed the panels and the inverter 2-weeks ago.They're true professionals and a testament to a fine company in Urban Renewables for the high quality & CLEAN installation works on our property.We're glad and thankful for choosing Urban Renewables and would highly recommend it to our friends, family and to our neighbors.Appreciate your service delivery which was 10/10 from end-to-end. Many thanks team @UR

Sales process conducted over phone and via a very prompt and comprehensive quote with estimates etc included via email.Installers arrived on time, completed the job in one day, excellent outcome. Polite and helpful.Commissioned the new battery, assisted with downloading the appropriate app to manage the battery and then showed us to how to use it.

This was the fourth project with Urban Renewables - the retrofit of a Sigenergy battery and EV charger to an existing Enphase system that UR installed for us a couple of years ago.Given that we were both new to the Sigenergy gear, and our past experience with Adrian and his crew, we agreed to do this job on a time and expense basis.Despite a few hiccups along the way (see my Sigenergy review) Adrian completed the task with patience and skill, completing the installation with no visible flexible conduit - one of my few mandatory requirements!

Initial information was thoughtful and relevant to our circumstancesThe sales and quoting process was efficient and timelyThe installation and commissioning was seamless.It was a very professional process from beginning to end
Quote was easy. Ended up getting 2 quotes.Installation took 2 days.Looks great, Works well.Guys were really friendly and helpful.Highly recommended

After a few cycles of quotes and bit of back and forth with a couple of other installers I settled on an Enphase system and between 16-18 panels.  Urban Renewables were local and had great reviews and they turned out to be an excellent choice for me.They did a pre-inspection in person to double check their design, offered a competitive price and were able to install earlier than their original 4 week estimate.  The installation was over 2 days and was carried out professionally and effectively and my neighbour who could see what was happening on my roof remarked that the team looked safe, efficient and focused on their tasks.There was a slight delay in the availability of a certification inspector and the back office were very helpful in following up and then assisting with the admin around the connection into the grid.Overall the company was easy to deal with and did a really good job and I have no hesitation in recommending them.

Adrian attended my address before I had accepted the quote to personally assess my roof for the suitability of, and best location for the panels.He carefully explained how the process worked and what to expect from the system.Installation was thoroughly completed and all packaging/rubbish removed afterwards in a timely manner.The electrical inspector complimented the neat and professional installation .

Sale and quoting was very transparent with various options offered after personal consultation. We opted for 8kw roof panels, a Fronius inverter and a Tesla 2 Powerwall. There was a waiting period over the summer break, but installations started on schedule.The installers were super-professional and one felt to be in very good, capable and experienced hands. Didn't mind little chats and important clarifications by the by.To my great surprise, the system kicked into life after 2 days of solid work in and above and under the house. (We did have a (much smaller) solar system before and already had a 2-way smart meter.) So far, we are very happy with what we got.

Everything went as expected, although there was no correspondence until the week of the installation. The ESV inspector said it was pleasing to see an installation done by a competent company that he never has issues with.

We obtained two quotes through Solar Quotes, and a third via friend's referral.  After bid conditioning, all three quotations were very close. I considered that Urban Renewables provided the best pre-purchase technical advice.  Installers were very professional, tidy.Still awaiting inspection and certification.

Urban Renewables recently completed an Enphase microinverter and Hanwha Q-Cell install on my roof. Solid team, super nice, extremely considerate and neat, wiring and labelling standards on point, left the place just as neat as prior to the works starting. Handover process was great, well explained. This is what you want from an electrical contractor. Highly recommended.Sales and quoting process was very easy, all done online and via email. Followed up with some phone calls. The team must have a decent pipeline of work as the works did take a few months to kick-off, but I don't consider that to be an issue.

This is the third time I have use Urban Renewals for installation of a solar system (different properties). They are very professional and friendly. The whole process from quoting to installation to follow up care goes smoothly. I would not hesitate to use Urban Renewals again.

Urban Renewables were great to deal with, a prompt, professional team who knew their stuff. Didn’t expect to have the job complete in less than a month from first contact and very happy with the result. A quality install which I am sure will provide ample energy, worry free for a long time.

Urban renewables provided a comprehensive quote with a couple of options of solar cells. Any questions were answered promptly and showed great knowledge of the products and process. Installer Jol and his team were professional, courteous, knowledgeable and very helpful during the installation. I would highly recommend Urban Renewables

The team from Urban Renewables were efficient and professional from the quote phase through to the after sales service. They guided me though the selection of equipment, installation and with setting up the software and user interface. They are also a Licenced Electrical Contractor which was the deciding factor for me. Happy to recommend these guys to all my friends.

Two good quality bids were received.  We selected Urban Renewables their proposal included a panel layout design and estimated power and cost savings data.  They offered solar panels manufactured in Malaysia that were competitive with other panels in terms of price, and also guarantee period(20 years).Three electricians did the installation, all were polite, arrived on time, completed the job in one day.  The installation is very professional, all cabling is in conduit that is completely hidden inside walls.  We’ve have a two story house and so running conduit from the roof of the second story through the wall cavities etc. was a fantastic effort, we were amazed that all conduit is hidden.The guys cleaned up when they finished, and gave some training on how the system worked and assisted to link up the inverter to the app on my phone.Highly recommend these guys.
Really supportive through the sales process. Happy to answer lots of questions and give objective points of viewSmooth installation process

Friendly and they knew their solar stuff (when comparing other providers) - installation looks good and they tidied up after themselves.Sales/quotation process was quick & easy.Installation: they were Polite, Tidy & PunctualEverything was complete and connected in a timely manner

The beginning to end experience with Urban Renewables was fantastic. The sales team and initial site inspection was focused on designing the best system for my property. Jol treated the install as if it were his own home - no ugly conduit anywhere, instead everything is neat, tidy, a top quality job. Everyone involved was professional and reliable. The post-install walkthrough was quick, easy, and by the time Jol and his team left I felt confident in managing and getting the most out of my new solar system. The admin team helping set up feed-in with the grid etc was also on top of things and made everything a breeze. Tip top job overall, will definitely be recommending Urban Renewables to friends and family.

Urban Renewables were recommended by a friend and were fantastic to deal with.  The quoting process was easy & quick and was great value for money.  The installers arrived on time and despite having to deal with a very tricky two story install were very pleasant and quick.  All rubbish was removed and place looked like they had never been here.  The Enlighten app was installed on our phones and fully explained.  Customer service was quick & efficient and we were connected to the grid within the week.  If you are looking to have solar installed Urban Renewables are your people.

No high pressure selling or up selling. Honest and clear advice. Very smooth process and installed much quicker than predicted. Handled all of the required paperwork that a third party can do. Local installer using own staff.

After many attempts & so called ‘solar experts’ advising on a system for us, we were recommended Urban Renewables Wbool.Their professionalism through the entire process was head & shoulders above all others.The install on our property was difficult - terracotta tiles & two story; everything amateur solar providers & in particular most, if not all other installers in Wbool are incapable of delivering, however not the case for Urban Renewables Wbool; they are so accommodating & professional, it is my pleaser to highly recommend them.
The sales/quoting process was very precise but flexible. The Installation and termination is tidy and the Customer Services (Ana) excellent and very helpful.
Quote was competitive but we chose quality of panels over price.Urban Renewables were great in their timing and follow up after installation.
Adrian at Urban Renewables was very helpful and gave us choices to suit our needs and wants. Installation was quick and clean, with plenty of communication as to start time etc.

- The sales/quoting process was transparent and upfront. They offered several solutions to meet budget and needs.- The installation was professional, safe and tidy.- Customer service was good. I was unaware of all the certificates, checks and changing meters involved. They helped us work through this.

We wished to use LG panels and Urban Renewals are listed as a local installer. We had no prior dealings with Urban Renewals so took a punt that LG would not list them unless their service was of a suitable standard.From the time of initial contact thru to installation, electrical inspection and finally supply of documentation to the energy retailer I have been impressed with this company. Everything was done on time, professionally and courteously. The installation crew we very polite, tidy and knew their stuff. The independent inspector came today and commented "these guys are the best". I don't know if they are the best but they are very good and would happily recommend them to others.

Once again top notch service from the team at Urban Renewables. This is the second system that they have installed for me. Working with Adrian and Jol to get the system designed and installed was easy. The install team including Jol were very accommodating and got everything done over 2 days ensuring that everything was 100% before they left.Really clean install, the panels are all perfectly aligned, the conduit required was minimal, tidy and straight.Independent safety inspector also reported that the install was exceptional and that there were zero items that needed to corrected before final sign off.Overall, really happy and have recommended them to anyone who has asked about our install / system.

After strong recommendations of Urban Renewables by dear friends, we started the process of adding solar panels and a battery to our property.The whole process went smoothly, even during the latter part of COVID Lockdown 6. After some form filling and discussions on the phone with Sean, everything went smoothly. Everything was clearly explained in a most friendly manner. We just and to wait a while for easing of Lockdown restrictions.The panels went up without a hitch. The cabling was installed simultaneously and it was all finished in one day.The battery and controller were added on another day (when tradies were allowed internal access) and the whole system was ready for the inspector in a few hours.The inspector came a few days later and he was very impressed by the work ... and so were we.After the installation was completed, we had a couple of questions which were promptly answered - again in a most friendly and professional manner.We can't recommend Urban Renewals highly enough!!

AAA+++Nothing but great things to say about Urban Renewables, right through from my initial enquiry, to installation and post install check-in.Every single person I spoke with and/or met,  was courteous, professional, reliable and easy to deal with. They are truly a great team...Thank you :)
Very quick to get back to me and and recommended only the best system, very happy with my dealings

Adrian contacted me for a quote and gave me the option to do it over the phone or in person (COVID).The installation is extremely tidy, Adrian cleaned up after himself, and it is evident that he actually takes pride in the work that he does.All I had to do was download my smart meter data so that Adrian could run the numbers and recommend a couple of systems based on our average usage and potential usage into the future.Adrian kept me informed via email throughout the whole process, he was punctual in attending when he said he would, my install looks great and everything was left neat and tidy.The customer service has been great, the grid connection was organised for me, all I have to do is arrange a suitable solar plan with my retailer.I highly recommend this installer.

Recently, we had Adrian Cole from Urban Renewables install a 6.6kw rooftop LG solar panel system at our house in Warrnambool. When we received Adrian's contact details via Solar Quotes, we contacted him and within a couple of days he visited for a pre-quotation inspection and then quickly followed up with a comprehensive quotation with 4 options presented. Considering the challenges of navigating around Covid-19 restrictions, Adrian was able to install our chosen system promptly and efficiently. We appreciated the way in which he communicated the installation process to us and his accessibility and ability in answering our questions during the whole process was first class. Adrian's work, equipment and materials presented minimal disruption to our household. Adrian also handled the Solar Victoria solar rebate application and communication with our power company. We were very impressed with Adrian's professional yet personable manner and throughly recommend him and his company Urban Renewables to interested purchasers.

Arranged for a quote of a 7.2kw system and the process of getting a quote to getting installed was simple and so professional. The quote was highly detailed with all the information i required to make an informative decision.  Sean assisted me from the sales side and the guys that came out onsite to do the install, where prompt, courteous and did the job exceptionally well.  The Enphase online monitoring software is brilliant and easy to use.  Would highly recommend

From the initial quote and site visit through to final commissioning the team at Urban Renewables have been great.  They are prompt and professional, provide great advice and their installation team are enthusiastic and efficient. I extremely happy with the system they supplied and installed and highly recommend the team at Urban Renewables.

Fantastic service. Couldn't be happier with the installation and workmanship. This along with the exceptional service I received throughout the whole process, was seamless. Kept me updated and informed throughout the whole process. Many thanks Urban Renewables.
Explained each step & kept in contact for each step. On time.
Everything was so good and we are very happy with the end result and using a local company.
Adrian turned up last Thursday when lockdown was announced, wasn't worth starting then.Quote was quick and the system was explained fully to me

Urban renewables, arrived on time, polite, tidy, and knowledgeable, especially Jol who came out to do the initial assessment. Fitted the system in a day and addressed our concerns regarding visibility from the road. The Customer service team (Ana) were very helpful both in arranging the timing of installation and providing all the paper work for connection to the grid. Globird contacted us within 24 hours thanks to Ana's e-mail and we are now up and running getting credit from United within 10 days from installation.  Production is matching the planned production for the time of year.Thanks to Solar Quotes for the recommendation and to Urban Renewables for a quality installation.

Installation was fantastic. Adrian is an excellent tradie and certainly knew his stuff. I was kept updated the whole time and you could see he took pride in his work. I cannot rate him highly enough. Thoroughly recommend his services. Thanks

* Decision about the configuration of the system, system size, quotes etc. was excellent. Sean was very helpful and quickly responded to numerous emails and requests I had for him.* Installation was quick and clean.* I'm not yet "connected" to my provider to get the FIT, but it's not the companies responsibility as well. They've sent my supplier all the required documents, explained the process and instructed me about what to do.--- So how's the system?* 4.4KW system.* Price was 3K$ after installation + 1.85K$ government interest-free loan for 4 years. (So total ~5K$)* Using the monitoring app, you can know "when" to run appliances, how much watt each one takes and try to build a"schedule" that will maximise power savings.*  The Enphase system isn't cheap, but it's still worth it IMO. (I have multiple splits on my roof, shading and other issues). Additionally, consumption monitoring really makes you notice how much energy you use and try to reduce it.*   So far We've saved 4 trees (2 Weeks with the system). It's nice knowing you're helping a bit with the climate crisis.Bottom line: very happy with Urban renewables and the overall process.

Urban Renewables was excellent to deal with from quote to installation. The advice and design were based on need and not upselling. The installation crew was on time, courteous, tidy completing the job in a day. Communication from the office was responsive and helpful. Very happy with our new Solar system. Have recommended Urban Renewables to friends considering solar.

Absolutely satisfied with the purchase of micro inverter solar system from Urban Renewables. Very professional  installation by Greg and team who were very courteous. Adrian has been a pleasure to deal with throughout the process, both before and after the installation. Would definitely recommend to friends.
It all went well from initial contact to explanation of options to installation

Very easy to deal with. Lots of technical information and the installation was quick and very professional. An all Aussi crew ensures a high standard of workmanship. I could fully recommend them form a domestic install.
Sales and quoting was prompt and process explainedGood installation, prompt attendance and good cleanupGood explanation of process post install to grid connection.

I’ve had a 14.4kw solar panel system using enphase micro inverters . This has been supplemented with the installation of 2x Tesla Powerwall batteries.Adrian and his team did a neat and professional installation. The team were onsite and careful not to break any roof tiles and also did neat installation and cabling. The team were always courteous and prompt . Certification was quick and efficient.
Excellent customer service and follow up support for rebate application. Professional and efficient installation. Great explanationof system and pros & cons of different options. Highly recommended.

The installers arrived on time; were employed directly by the company; and everything was completed in 1 day.After-sales service was excellent: the Electrical Inspector arrived well within the specified period and much to my surprise, even the electricity wholesaler completed their work within 48 hours, rather than a possible 30 days. While the system has only been in full operation for a week or so, everything to do with this job has been completed perfectly and I highly recommend Urban Renewables Pty. Ltd.
Very  very happy with the overall experience with Urban Renewables and Greg great company and great bloke.

Very happy with this solar company.They gave us good information and advice about what system to have installed and answered all questions.Excellent installation job. High quality products used. System up and running with excellent output. They helped us with all the admin to have it connected. There was torrential rain the day after install and no roof leaks!Price was mid-range compared to several other quotes, we are always happy to pay a bit more for good service from local trades.

The whole process has been a good experience for us even through the COVID lockdown. Adrian was easy to talk to and had a wealth of knowledge to impart which made our decision on the type of system for our circumstance, albeit a little more expensive, but in the end the right choice after he helped us with all the pros and cons and system comparisions. In fact the three companies I dealt with via the SolarQuotes website were all very helpful and not pushy at all. One other I conntacted before I discovered SolarQuotes was downright abusive when I told them I was using someone else.The whole team are helpful and took everything out of our hands as far as paperwork and getting connected to the grid. The workmanship is first rate and everything looks very neat as the inspector confirmed that he can never fault their work. We look forward to many years of being comfortable in the knowledge we are not pilaging and polluting the environment as we were.
Urban Renewables are experts and provide a high quality install. I am very happy with my solar.   Adrian, Joel and Ana were all fantastic to deal with. I would highly recommend.

The Urban Renewables team were very helpful in discussing the right system and booking it in. They were not at all pushy with their marketing; a stark contrast to many other providers. The installation was done very punctually and they have done a very neat job. Throughout the whole process they have been very easy to contact and helpful with all queries. The service has been outstanding through the whole process (deciding on the right system, assisting with applying for the government rebates, booking, installation, setting up feed-in tariffs with the local distributer, checking in after installation). Highly recommended.

Before the quote Adrian explained all the options and tradeoffs really clearly, and Joel came around for a site inspection and determined how many panels could be fitted.The system we agreed upon maximised the available space on our roof (we managed 6.66kW of panels), used premium products (Fronius inverter, Longi panels, Radiant rails) and provided excellent guarantees (10 years workmanship, 5 years whole of system). The price was highly competitive.The installation was trouble free, the team were tidy, punctual, polite, professional and friendly. They did an excellent job - our roof looks great! The inspector was very impressed with the installation.The team also gave advice on organising the grid connection and choosing a better value electricity retailer.Couldn't be happier with the performance of the system so far. September's electricity bill came to the princely sum of $16!I also purchased the Fronius Smart Meter which I love, as I can track the power the panels are generating and switch on appliances accordingly. I can also check the electricity bill, and monitor our return on investment.I would thoroughly recommend Urban Renewables.
Competitive and easy to understand quote with inverter/panels size options.  Installation was prompt and professional. I'm very happy with the overall process.
from first contact to installation, Adrian was very good in explaining the system options and then putting it on the roof himself. quick installation, ood to know our solar is now humming along!

Installation was great. They were on time, efficient and left the place spotless.Adrian in the office was extremely helpful and assisted with all paperwork which made the process a lot easier.Would highly recommend.
Adrian helped me sort through issues with Powercor and cut absolutely no corners with a well-thought-out and clean install.

Very impressed with the whole team:Adrain for quoting and adviceJoel for his advice, expertise and attention to detailAna for her efficiency and help with what was to be done.A great team who were very customer focused and wanting a great outcome for me, the customer

I have been very happy with Urban Renewables.  They were the only company to attend our house prior to quoting, and the plan / location of panels and choice of panels/system made more sense to us.  They have backed this up with polite, efficient installation and very helpful after sales advice.  I would have no hesitation in recommending them.

A simple quoting system so easy compared to the sales tactics of other installers. Adrian contacted me direct and ran through the details. They had one of the better quotes on good quality panels + inverter. 6.6KW panels into 5KW inverter due to roof aspects. Installers came when scheduled and were more than happy to discuss inverter location pros and cons. Installation was very clean and neat, cleared up everything afterwards. They had to spend a bit of extra time on fuse panel to make space for the Smart meter, so install took 1.5 days. Very friendly and I talked with them about the install. two different Inspectors came, the Government inspector said the install was very good.It has been working perfectly for the last 2 months now.

Urban Renewables were recommended through a friend.Extremely professional attitude and service, punctual, friendly, old fashioned deliver as promised no fuss.Quoting was simple and fast.  Installation was super smooth, tidy and efficient.  Left everything as they found it, rubbish removed, no sign of them remaining other than a very neat PV system.Customer service and assistance after installation fantastic, prompt and very helpful, inspections and connection process monitored by UR with instructions on steps right through the process.Cannot speak highly enough about a great experience, thank you Adrian & team!

Stayed in touch with me via email on design and Government Rebate process.  Accurate quoting, turned up on time to install.   Good after sales service with installing software to monitor.   Very impressed.

I dealt with one of the two owners during quoting and they (Adrian) were very helpful.  I was provided with a choice of panel brand, Inverter brand and providd their pricing in a table format for easy comparison by me.Their team arrived on the day as arranged and installed the panels, cabling, Inverter and Fronius Meter ( the price below does include the $350 charged for the add-on Fronius Meter, that I requested ), completing and leaving the site clean and tidy at day's end.The Inverter was installed in my garage (my choice) so I was pleased with that outcome as well.Post-installation service was also great with Ana managing electrical inspection and submitting outcomes through the portal.The Electrical Inspector passed their quality of work and signed off on 1st visit - quite pleasing.It was easy decision for me to rate them five out of five.Would not hesitate to recommend Urban Renewables (Seemless, worry-free and pride in their workmanship)

Urban Renewables did our rooftop solar installation and meter upgrade in January. They were very responsive to all our queries during the quote process and did an excellent job on installation itself. They worked cleanly and efficiently and were pleasant to have on site. It seemed very good value for all the work they did. Their 'after-care' with getting the meter switched over etc has also been attentive.
Very knowledgeable people, responsive.

We are 100% happy with our installation after 5 months in operation. Adrian and his team provide a quality service at great prices. The whole transaction was seamless and they are always willing to help, even after the system installation.

Great team, it never felt like I was getting pushed into things or talked into getting something I donâ€™t need. The communication and support especially around obtaining the Vic solar rebate was exceptional and very much appreciated. Great follow up.

I had had 4 previous quotes on solar systems but none were competitive.Urban Renewables made contact with me the day I requested information and within 2 hours I had received a call from Rory. He provided an accurate quote within 2 hours using Google Maps and Near Maps and I ended up being able to afford a larger and better system then I had thought based on previous quotes.On the day of installation, they turned up as planned, the system was installed and was working that day. The rest of the paperwork has also been submitted for me too.As a new user of solar, I know that I could call if I had any questions as their customer service continues after installation if needed.
The company is based in Melbourne but the installer is local, very professional and very obliging!

I'm very happy with our interactions with Urban Renewables and they were very accommodating to our needs and timeline. We were in the middle of a second storey extension and the panels were installed on the new flat roof. Urban Renewables turned up on schedule, worked well with the other trades and performed their work flawlessly.Adrian provided excellent customer services, answering all our questions and was prompt with responses, even following up on the weekend.
Professional attended site no pressure quality products and the install was done professionally would recommend Urban renewalsNote have recommend solarquotes to work mates

This company was a local company that worked so well with me from that first phone call to a follow up email a month after installation to check my meter had been changed over. Cannot recommend them more highly.If you what someone to actually come out and get on your roof for a quote and inspection these are your guys.

Urban Renewables came out and quoted on a Saturday and advised us through the process to apply for the State rebate. Installation of 16 LG 350 Solar Panels with Enphase Micro Inverters (IQ7) on to our steel roof was all done in 1 day; the installers were friendly and efficient, cleaned up and completed all of their work that day. We are able to see what the panels are generating every day and so far it has been above expectations. We have 7 panels facing North and 9 facing West, the North facing start work at around 0700 and are most effective. Recommend Urban Renewables to people who want the job done properly. The quote was competitive with other installers' similar systems.
Extremely happy with the service we received from all staff members. They are not pushy like many other solar companies and give great advice

Great company to deal with - Adrian was prompt with site visit and quote, willing to quote on various configurations based on quality, cost and performance of system.Time and date booked to suit, Joel and the team were on time - project completed as planned with little fuss and exactly what was quoted, 1st class install and attention to detail.Tania from Customer Service followed up and arranged all post details to ensure electrical certificate completed and grid connection paper work in place --  made the whole process easy.Would not hesitate to recommend Urban for all solar connections. Thanks

Fantastic experience dealing with this company. There was no short cuts and no cheapies. Adrian took time to explain and detail our needs regarding system in into the future.Greg and guys completed installation in one day that being 26 panels and left place spotless after completion, they were polite and always happy to answer any questions. Tania was a bundle of help keeping me updated regarding inspections and required paper work. Always punctual regarding getting back to me and starting and completing works. I would not hesitate in recommending this company to my family and closet friends. Ray Mifsud.

Adrian promptly came to visit the property once I made the request and quickly provide an informative quote at a competitive price for a great system. Adrian supported me through the state rebate online process and quickly organised installation once I was approved. Installation was completely within 2 weeks of approval and all went smoothly. I highly recommend Urban Renewables for solar installation.

The installer was excellent in communicating the products and installation process.  Also assisted with the rebate and provided advice about retailers (feed-in tariffs etc).  The installation was efficient, and staff were respectful.  Overall very satisfied and have no hesitation in recommending their services.

Installation was quick and efficient. They came early in the morning because the weather forecast didn't look great on the day and managed to finish the install in 6 hours. The job was done properly and was not rushed. Set up the inverter and went through the paperwork with me and explained the process after. Cleaned up well.I only rated them with a 4/5 for customer service due to them being a small team and not being able to get back to me ASAP. This was especially crucial while trying to navigate the new VIC solar rebate system on the first day it was open. Besides that, Adrian and his team was professional and courteous at all times.Will not hesitate to recommend.
Very professional, everything was done on time as promised. Highly recommend

Great service from Urban Renewables. No pushy sales, just honest advice and comparable pricing and recommendations as others. Chose them because they are local, but have been happy with the quality of advice, installation and support through the process.

I used Solar Quotes to cull down to 3 suppliers and found Urban to fit my criteria: high feed back rating from others, good quality systems and advice and reasonable pricing.  Trina and Enphase - 3 phase system.  I wanted a reliable system and reliable team so knew I had to pay a bit more - which has definitely paid off. (The Vic Govt rebate is also very helpful - thanks you)  Adrian did not hesitate to provide recent installations as referees and these people spoke at length of the excellent experience, as can I.  Joel did a very professional installation - I went up on the roof and we finalised the layout there - on time and very neat circuit board set up - the Electrical Inspector says he sees that without exception from Adrian and Joel - another good point.  The panels came on board and the enphase monitoring/App as been spot on - we thought we had an issue with one panel - I can see output from each panel, but a software upgrade sorted all that - as Adrian predicted.  All the admin team are very professional and on the ball - they had all the paper work organised very quickly to get my rebate claim in.  I can not speak too highly of them  Thanks Urban Renewables team.  Great job.  Jim
A great all round experience, excellent communications, great knowledge, speedy installation and follow up
